visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Letters Are Counted Instead of Words
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The two most common words are the (3 times) and and (2 times), but the program counts single characters.
visualizerParams.buggyCode:
from collections import Counter

text = "the cat and the hat and the bat"
counts = Counter(text)
print(counts.most_common(2))

solution.code:
from collections import Counter

text = "the cat and the hat and the bat"
counts = Counter(text.split())
print(counts.most_common(2))
solution.explanation: Counter counts the items of whatever iterable it is given. A string is an iterable of characters, so Counter(text) counts letters and spaces. split() first turns the text into a list of words.
